title: Antler Ridge at Eagles Nest | KEY.co
description_expanded: Stay entertained with a 65-inch smart TV and ceiling fan in the room, and indulge in the privacy of the exquisite ensuite bathroom. Pamper yourself with the tiled shower featuring two showerheads, while the double granite vanity, heated floors, and separate water closet add an extra touch of luxury. Upstairs, a loft awaits, offering a recreational area for endless entertainment. Engage in friendly competition with video games, board games, or a game of pool. The second king suite is a cozy haven, complete with a 65-inch smart TV, ceiling fan, and a comfortable leather chair, perfect for curling up with your favorite novel. Its attached bathroom features a tiled combination tub/shower and double granite vanity. Ideal for families or groups, the bunk suite in the third bedroom accommodates up to six guests. This charming space includes a 42-inch smart TV, a twin-over-twin bunk with a trundle, and a twin over a full bunk. The accompanying bathroom features a tiled shower and double granite vanity, ensuring comfort and convenience for all. Outside, the expansive deck offers breathtaking mountain views in every direction. Immerse yourself in relaxation as you soak in the brand-new eight-person hot tub. Enjoy the wood-burning fireplace or fire up the mainlined gas grill for an unforgettable outdoor dining experience. Lounge on the comfortable cushioned sofa, loveseat, and chair while catching your team's game on the 65-inch smart TV. Indulge in the ultimate vacation experience at this exceptional home. Book your stay now and make memories that will last a lifetime.
